card.text: Explore Anthe, a small moon of Saturn, through its measured shape.

introduction.text: Anthe is a tiny moon between Mimas and Enceladus, accompanied by a faint arc of dust. Cassini detected it, but did not resolve its shape accurately.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: A 1 km sphere represents the estimated size. The actual shape is unresolved; gray grid: no surface imagery.
